description: Group near-duplicates/bursts from up to 100 IDs/paths using 64-bit dHash of current JPEG previews (minimum edge 64) and raw capture time. Every pair must meet inclusive time_window_seconds (default 5) and max_hamming_distance (default 10). Input-order groups omit singletons and repeated photos. Similarity does not rank frames. photos gives raw capture_time in Lightroom seconds (second precision, no timezone normalization). No hash cache or catalog changes. At 20 s returns the groups so far and the unreached inputs as remaining; preview and missing-time failures are failed with reasons. The photo open in Develop gets no thumbnail, since Lightroom's thumbnail there can be stale or an enlarged low-resolution copy: it fails at once, naming render_photo; for that photo take one look before editing and one after, not one per step. Resend remaining together with the originals to grow groups.
name: find_duplicate_groups
title: Find duplicate groups
